moment: Starry night sky full of floating candles, in rows with broomstick line-drawings
why: Floating candles against stars is the Great Hall's enchanted ceiling. The fletched strokes read as broomsticks.

moment: Yellow scooter on the shore of Pangong Lake, with a row of sketched boxes and the last one circled
why: A Ladakh high-altitude lake with a yellow scooter on the pebbles is the film's finale location. The overlay graphic is unclear.

moment: Wilderness camp at night: two tents and a small fire under the mountains
why: A frontier night camp fits the RDR2 camp mood, but alone it is generic.

moment: Dimmed ghost galleon behind Jack Sparrow's compass, with a dotted waypoint line dropping down
why: Tattered black-sailed ship plus an ornate octagonal compass like Jack's.

moment: The Black Pearl under a storm-lit moon, a dotted gold trail ending at an X
why: Ragged black sails on a dark galleon is the Black Pearl, plus the X-marks-the-spot trail.

moment: Open sketchbook: red rule, taped note, a wireframe grid crossed out
why: Designer's notebook; no film or game cue.

moment: Night sea under storm clouds, a bioluminescent wave, a lone lit ship on the horizon
why: A lone square-rigger at night suggests pirates. The glowing sea could also be Life of Pi, so I'm only moderately confident.

moment: Red-sky frontier ranch, with X markers scattered in the sky
why: Lone oak, homestead and split-rail fence under a blood-red sky is RDR2 key-art language. The Xs read as map or target markers.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolding: banner, compass roses, inked corridors
why: Folded parchment with a ribbon banner and corridor outlines is clearly the Marauder's Map. No footprints are visible in this frame, but the layout matches.

moment: Red-tinted ranch at dusk, a trail of X waypoints along the dirt road, crows overhead
why: Same western-homestead image. The waypoint trail feels like a game map route.

moment: Astronaut pen in its velvet case beside a stopwatch on the lecture desk
why: An heirloom pen presented in a box in an Indian college classroom, with a stopwatch: the pen-that-writes-in-space scene.

moment: Sunlit classroom chalkboard: drone sketch, a row of bars with one highlighted
why: The drone ties it to the 3 Idiots set. The arched stone window also reads as Hogwarts, so I'm not sure.

moment: Saddled horse grazing in a golden river valley at sunset
